questions.prompt: Within how many seconds should you greet a guest who enters your area?
questions.explanation: Role Overview → Key standards: greet every guest within 10 seconds.

questions.prompt: Above what amount does a compensation require Duty Manager approval?
questions.explanation: Role Overview → Key standards: never promise compensation over $50 without approval.

questions.prompt: Which of these are part of the end-of-shift routine? (Select all that apply)
choices: Close or reassign every open task
questions.explanation: Role Overview → Shift structure. Walking the lobby and pulling arrivals are start-of-shift tasks.

questions.prompt: You may confirm a guest's room number to a caller who says they are the guest's spouse.
questions.explanation: Communication Standards → Confidentiality: never confirm a room number to anyone but the registered guest.

questions.prompt: What is the maximum time a guest should be left on hold without checking back?
questions.explanation: Communication Standards → On the phone: check back within 60 seconds.

choices: Answer the phone within 10 seconds, reply to email within 5 minutes
Make eye contact at 10 feet, greet verbally at 5 feet
10 guests per coordinator, 5 per shift lead
Reply to messages within 10 minutes, calls within 5

questions.prompt: Guest messages received during your shift should be answered within:
questions.explanation: Communication Standards → In writing: reply within 15 minutes.
